description: This file defines the class Zend_Translate_Adapter_Csv, which is a translation adapter for handling CSV translation files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for loading translation data from CSV files and returning the adapter's name.

classes.name: Zend_Translate_Adapter_Csv
classes.description: A translation adapter class for reading CSV files and providing translation data within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CSV translation adapter with data, locale, and options.

methods.name: _loadTranslationData
methods.description: Loads translation data from a CSV file into the adapter, parsing the CSV content and handling comments and empty values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter, 'Csv'.
